options.unbounded: Unbounded (wide, bold geometric display) for headlines, Geist for text, Geist Mono for labels and numbers.
options.syne: Syne (quirky, art-school display) for headlines, Inter for text and numbers.
options.space: Space Grotesk for headlines and text, IBM Plex Mono for labels and numbers.
options.serif: Instrument Serif (elegant editorial serif) for headlines, Geist for text, Geist Mono for numbers.
options.archivo: Archivo (extra-condensed, heavy) for headlines, Archivo for text, JetBrains Mono for numbers.
